normalization.tokenizer_assurance: The splitter keeps commas within parenthetical text inside one token. Parenthetical repeated INCI aliases were mapped only where the resulting canonical form already exists in the frozen dictionary.

new_entry_source_coverage.disposition: Every new entry has an exact product-declaration reference and a pending CosIng/primary-supplier function reference, but no unverified function has been promoted. Root review must either supply exact function evidence or retain these entries as unresolved before any classifier reads the dictionary.

closed_family_checks.reused_exact_family_hits: Existing frozen entries retain their prior flags, including ALCOHOL DENAT., recognized silicones, POLYSILICONE-15, declared fragrance/allergens, and rosemary extract.
closed_family_checks.new_entries: All new entries carry all five closed-family fields. AROMA is the sole new exact fragrance declaration marked true; all other new-family negatives are stated as closed-list exclusions, not general safety or performance claims.
closed_family_checks.uv_filter: No new identity is marked an UV filter. Existing POLYSILICONE-15 stays bound to the frozen base dictionary; source-side product claim review remains separate.

penetration_boundary: No new penetration anchor is added. The new entries explicitly retain only the current three exact admitted forms as the possible anchor set and do not infer penetration or nonpenetration.
blocked_or_ambiguous_identity_notes: Organic qualifiers are retained as part of the raw token. Only Organic Decolorized Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Oil and Organic Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract are mapped to pre-existing exact-form dictionary identities; organic Calendula and Coconut fruit-oil forms remain new identities.
AROMA is a generic declaration and intentionally has no expanded constituent list.
Gardenia enfleurage oil, Santalum wood extract, and the new botanical fixed oils have no promoted cosmetic function in this staging packet.
No source was used to infer hair weight, residue, base, film, finished-product behavior, or persistence.
classifier_boundary: Do not provide this folder to a classifier until root freezes the normalized list and resolves the pending exact-function evidence.
